name: stack-item
description: A single row primitive used by list-like containers such as list-view and tree-view.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Row background; fills when the item is selected or highlighted.

anatomy.name: checkbox
anatomy.description: Selection checkbox shown in a selection mode.

anatomy.name: visual
anatomy.description: Icon or thumbnail at the start of the content.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Text of the item; the relationships set its minimum width.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Row of action buttons at the end of the item.

anatomy.name: disclosure-indicator
anatomy.description: Chevron that marks the item as navigable.

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline drawn around the row for keyboard focus.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web List view item (Drag handle, Content: visual + text + actions, Navigation indicator). The part name header comes from the relationship scope; Figma calls it Visual + Text. Selection checkbox inferred from Selection mode.
